name: LLAS 2011W
title: Introduction to Latino-American Writing and Research
description: Students refine writing skills and learn how and where to conduct transnational academic research on the Latino-American experience. Interdisciplinary approaches, historical background of Latino American studies. CA 4.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011 or instructor consent; open to sophomores or higher. Recommended preparation: 1000-level introductory course on Latino or Latin American Studies.
